localChanges: The city screen's yields are now a row each, with a bar of what the city makes. The bar shows the part it uses (food eaten, shields supporting units, trade lost to corruption, gold for upkeep), what's spare, and in red what it's short. Every bar is drawn to the same scale, so they compare at a glance (closes #719).
Luxuries, tax and science now have a row each, so the gold a city's improvements cost to keep shows beside the gold it makes.
